According to the API documentation, `Arrays.asList` can throw two types of exceptions: `NullPointerException` if the specified array is `null`, and `ArrayStoreException` if the actual component type of the array differs from the type parameter T. In the given code, `stanza` is passed directly to `Arrays.asList`, which internally creates a single-element array of type `Deliverable`. There is no explicit check for `null` before calling `Arrays.asList`, so `NullPointerException` is not avoided. However, since `stanza` is of type `Deliverable` and the method expects an array of type `Deliverable`, there is no type mismatch, so `ArrayStoreException` is avoided.
